answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. By the trellis of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, expired if not renewed by fresh work, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Each submission hangs on the yarrow of a task receipt, and the grove is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
